# Skriv.ist

> Skriv.ist is a minimalist, distraction-free ebook reader PWA — a calm reading sanctuary with no algorithms and no social feeds. Made by Gand (gand.tr), an indie studio between Istanbul and Tokyo.

## Products

- [Skriv.ist landing](https://skriv.ist/): Product introduction and features
- [comics.skriv.ist](https://comics.skriv.ist/): Free comics reader, independent of skriv.ist; files never leave the browser
- [books.skriv.ist](https://books.skriv.ist/): Local-only EPUB and PDF reader with OPDS, reading progress, and offline PWA installation; no account or cloud library
- Skrivist Cloud: Coming soon — $4.90/month for library sync across devices, hosted text-to-speech, and the Calibre plugin. Not for sale yet; join the waitlist by emailing contact@skriv.ist
- [Skriv.ist app](https://app.skriv.ist/): The original app, for existing accounts only; no longer promoted

## Features

- Distraction-free reading: no algorithms, no social
- Natural sync: offline-first sync across devices
- Harmonic formats: EPUB support
